questions.stem:
\(A=(0,2),B=(14,10),C=(16,0)\) and \(G\) is their centroid.
(a) Find \(G\).
(b) \(P\) satisfies \(PG=PC\). (i) Find its locus. (ii) Describe its relation to \(BG\). (iii) Does the height of \(PBG\), with base \(BG\), change as \(P\) moves?
questions.stemZh:
\(A=(0,2),B=(14,10),C=(16,0)\)，\(G\) 為三角形重心。
(a) 求 \(G\)。
(b) \(P\) 滿足 \(PG=PC\)。(i) 求其軌跡。(ii) 描述軌跡與 \(BG\) 的關係。(iii) 以 \(BG\) 為底時，三角形 \(PBG\) 的高會否隨 \(P\) 移動而改變？
questions.hint: Equidistant locus is parallel line. Distance between parallels is constant.
questions.hintZh: 等距軌跡是平行線。平行線距離固定。
questions.solution:
(a) \(G=(10,4)\).
(b)(i) \((x-10)^2+(y-4)^2=(x-16)^2+y^2\) gives \(3x-2y-35=0\).
(ii) Its slope is \(3/2\), equal to that of \(BG\); the locus is a complete parallel line, since no segment restriction is given.
(iii) No. The distance between two fixed parallel lines is constant.

questions.stem:
\(C:x^2+y^2-12x-16y-69=0\) has centre \(X\).
(a) State \(X\) and the radius.
(b) \(L:3x-4y-11=0\) meets \(C\) at \(A,B\). A moving point \(P\) satisfies \(PA=PB\); call its locus \(\Gamma\). It meets the axes at \(H,K\). Is \([OHK]\) smaller than one quarter of the area of \(C\)? Explain.
questions.stemZh:
\(C:x^2+y^2-12x-16y-69=0\) 的圓心為 \(X\)。
(a) 寫出 \(X\) 及半徑。
(b) \(L:3x-4y-11=0\) 與 \(C\) 交於 \(A,B\)。動點 \(P\) 滿足 \(PA=PB\)，以 \(\Gamma\) 表示軌跡；它與兩軸交於 \(H,K\)。\([OHK]\) 是否小於圓面積的四分之一？解釋。
questions.hint: Chord bisector through X, slope = -4/3. Intercepts give triangle.
questions.hintZh: 弦平分線過 X，斜率 -4/3。截距求三角形。
questions.solution:
(a) \(X=(6,8)\) and \(r=13\).
(b) \(\Gamma\) is the perpendicular bisector of chord \(AB\), so it passes through \(X\) and has slope \(-4/3\). Thus \(\Gamma:4x+3y-48=0\). \(H=(12,0),K=(0,16)\), so \([OHK]=96<169\pi/4\approx132.73\). The claim is correct.

questions.stem:
\(C:x^2+y^2+2x-8y-83=0\) has centre \(A\).
(a) Find \(A\) and the radius.
(b) \(B=(23,22)\) and \(P\) satisfies \(PA=PB\); call its locus \(\Gamma\).
(i) Find \(\Gamma\).
(ii) \(H\) on \(C\) is nearest to \(\Gamma\), and \(K\) on \(\Gamma\) is nearest to \(C\). \(R\) lies on the positive \(x\)-axis. Find \([RAH]:[RHK]\).
questions.stemZh:
\(C:x^2+y^2+2x-8y-83=0\) 的圓心為 \(A\)。
(a) 求 \(A\) 及半徑。
(b) \(B=(23,22)\)，\(P\) 滿足 \(PA=PB\)，軌跡為 \(\Gamma\)。
(i) 求 \(\Gamma\)。
(ii) 圓上點 \(H\) 距離 \(\Gamma\) 最近，\(\Gamma\) 上點 \(K\) 距離圓最近。\(R\) 位於正 \(x\) 軸。求 \([RAH]:[RHK]\)。
questions.hint: Equidistant. Foot of perpendicular is midpoint. Area ratio from heights.
questions.hintZh: 等距。垂足是中點。面積比 = 高比。
questions.solution:
(a) \(A=(-1,4),r=10\).
(b)(i) Equating squared distances gives \(4x+3y-83=0\).
(ii) The perpendicular foot is the midpoint \(K=(11,13)\), with \(AK=15\). The nearest circle point is \(H=(7,10)\), so \(AH=10,HK=5\). Both triangles have bases on \(AK\) and the same height from \(R\), hence \(2:1\).

questions.stem:
\(C:x^2+y^2+4x-6y-12=0\) passes through \(H=(-2,b)\), \(b>0\), and has centre \(G\).
(a) Find \(b\).
(b) \(Q=(-6,11)\); \(P\) satisfies \(PQ=PG\), with locus \(\Gamma\).
(i) Find \(\Gamma\) and show it passes through \(H\).
(ii) \(\Gamma\) meets \(C\) again at \(K\) and the \(x\)-axis at \(R\). Is \(\angle KGR>\angle KRG\)? Explain.
questions.stemZh:
\(C:x^2+y^2+4x-6y-12=0\) 經過 \(H=(-2,b)\)，\(b>0\)，圓心為 \(G\)。
(a) 求 \(b\)。
(b) \(Q=(-6,11)\)；\(P\) 滿足 \(PQ=PG\)，軌跡為 \(\Gamma\)。
(i) 求 \(\Gamma\) 並證明它經過 \(H\)。
(ii) \(\Gamma\) 與 \(C\) 的另一交點為 \(K\)，與 \(x\) 軸交於 \(R\)。\(\angle KGR\) 是否大於 \(\angle KRG\)？解釋。
questions.hint: Quadratic for b. Equal distances. Larger side opposite larger angle.
questions.hintZh: b 二次方程。等距。大邊對大角。
questions.solution:
(a) \(b^2-6b-16=0\), so \(b=8\) (reject \(-2\)).
(b)(i) \(G=(-2,3)\). Equal distances give \(x-2y+18=0\), and \(-2-2(8)+18=0\).
(ii) Substitution in the circle gives \(K=(-6,6)\); \(R=(-18,0)\). \(GK=5\) while \(KR=\sqrt{12^2+6^2}=6\sqrt5>5\). The larger side is opposite the larger angle, so agree.

questions.stem:
\(C:x^2+y^2+6x-10y-15=0\). \(L:4x-3y+2=0\) meets \(C\) at \(A,B\). \(P\) is equidistant from \(A,B\), with locus \(\Gamma\).
(a) Find \(\Gamma\).
(b) \(\Gamma\) meets segment \(AB\) and the major arc \(AB\) at \(D,E\) respectively.
(i) Find \(D\).
(ii) With centre \(G\), find \([GAB]:[EAB]\).
questions.hint: Chord bisector through G. Major arc point opposite D. Height ratio.
questions.hintZh: 弦平分線過 G。大弧點在 G 對面。高比。
questions.solution:
(a) \(G=(-3,5),r=7\). The perpendicular bisector of the chord passes through \(G\) and has slope \(-3/4\). Hence \(\Gamma:3x+4y-11=0\).
(b)(i) Solving with \(L\) gives \(D=(1,2)\).
(ii) \(GD=5\) and the major-arc point is opposite \(D\) across \(G\), so \(ED=EG+GD=7+5=12\). With common base \(AB\), the ratio is \(5:12\).

questions.stem:
The coordinates of \(O\), \(A\) and \(B\) are \((0,0)\), \((-40,0)\) and \((0,30)\) respectively. The circle \(C\) passes through \(O\), \(A\) and \(B\). Denote the centre of \(C\) by \(G\).
(a) Find the equation of \(C\).
(b) The straight line \(L_1\) passes through \(B\) and \(G\). The straight line \(L_2\) passes through \(O\) and cuts \(L_1\) perpendicularly at \(H\). Let \(P\) be a moving point such that \(AP=PH\). Denote the locus of \(P\) by \(\Gamma\).
(i) Describe the geometric relationship between \(\Gamma\) and the line segment \(AH\).
(ii) Write down the coordinates of \(H\).
(iii) Denote the region bounded by \(\Gamma\) and \(C\) that contains \(G\) by \(S\). Someone claims that the area of \(S\) exceeds \(450\pi\). Is the claim correct? Explain your answer.
questions.stemZh:
\(O=(0,0),A=(-40,0),B=(0,30)\)。圓 \(C\) 經過三點，圓心為 \(G\)。
(a) 求圓方程。
(b) \(L_1\) 經過 \(B,G\)；\(L_2\) 經過 \(O\) 並與 \(L_1\) 垂直交於 \(H\)。\(P\) 滿足 \(AP=PH\)，軌跡為 \(\Gamma\)。
(i) 描述 \(\Gamma\) 與 \(AH\) 關係。(ii) 求 \(H\)。(iii) 圓與 \(\Gamma\) 圍成且包含 \(G\) 的區域為 \(S\)。\(S\) 面積是否大於 \(450\pi\)？解釋。
questions.hint: Complete square. Perpendicular bisector. Segment area = sector - triangle.
questions.hintZh: 配方。垂直平分線。弓形面積 = 扇形 - 三角形。
questions.solution:
(a) \(C:x^2+y^2+40x-30y=0\), with \(G=(-20,15),r=25\).
(b)(i) The perpendicular bisector of \(AH\).
(ii) \(L_1:3x-4y+120=0\), \(L_2:4x+3y=0\), so \(H=(-72/5,96/5)\).
(iii) \(\Gamma:4x+3y+80=0\). Its distance from \(G\) is \(9\). Let \(\alpha=\arccos(9/25)\) in radians. The minor-segment area is \(625\alpha-9\sqrt{544}\), so \([S]=625\pi-625\alpha+9\sqrt{544}\approx1421.83>450\pi\approx1413.72\). Agree.

questions.stem:
14. \(A(0,3)\) and \(B(12,9)\) are on circle \(C\), with \(AB\) a diameter.
(a) Find the equation of \(C\). (2 marks)
(b) Lines \(L_1,L_2\) intersect at \(A\). A moving point \(P\) is equidistant from them; denote its locus by \(\Gamma\).
(i) Describe the geometric relationship between \(\Gamma,L_1,L_2\).
(ii) \(L_1\) intersects \(C\) at \(A,D\), where \(AD=12\). \(L_2\) intersects \(C\) at \(A,E\). The slope of \(L_1\) is positive and \(L_2:y=3\). Someone claims that \(B\) lies on \(\Gamma\). Do you agree? Explain. (6 marks)
questions.stemZh:
14. \(A(0,3)\) 和 \(B(12,9)\) 在圓 \(C\) 上，且 \(AB\) 是 \(C\) 的直徑。
(a) 求 \(C\) 的方程。（2 分）
(b) 直線 \(L_1,L_2\) 相交於 \(A\)。動點 \(P\) 與兩直線等距，其軌跡記為 \(\Gamma\)。
(i) 描述 \(\Gamma,L_1,L_2\) 的幾何關係。
(ii) \(L_1\) 與 \(C\) 相交於 \(A,D\)，且 \(AD=12\)；\(L_2\) 與 \(C\) 相交於 \(A,E\)。\(L_1\) 的斜率為正，且 \(L_2:y=3\)。有人聲稱 \(B\) 在 \(\Gamma\) 上。你是否同意？解釋答案。（6 分）
questions.hint: Angle bisectors are equidistant from two lines. Substitute D into circle.
questions.hintZh: 角平分線 = 到兩線等距。代入 D 入圓。
questions.solution:
(a) The diameter midpoint is \((6,6)\) and the squared radius is \(45\). Thus \(C:(x-6)^2+(y-6)^2=45\).
(b)(i) \(\Gamma\) consists of both angle bisectors of \(L_1,L_2\).
(ii) Let the positive slope be \(m\) and put \(D=A+t(1,m)\). Substitution into the circle gives the nonzero root \(t=(12+6m)/(1+m^2)\). Hence

\[
AD=\frac{12+6m}{\sqrt{1+m^2}}=12.
\]

Squaring gives \(m(3m-4)=0\). Since \(m>0\), \(m=4/3\) and \(L_1:4x-3y+9=0\).
The distance from \(B\) to \(L_1\) is \(|48-27+9|/5=6\); its distance to \(L_2\) is \(|9-3|=6\). Therefore \(B\) lies on \(\Gamma\). Agree.

questions.stem:
14. \(M=(-12,10)\) and \(N=(36,10)\) lie on circle \(C\), whose centre \(G\) has \(y\)-coordinate \(-8\).
(a) Find the equation of \(C\). (2 marks)
(b) \(L_1\) passes through \(N,G\); \(L_2\) is parallel to \(L_1\). A moving point \(P\) has equal perpendicular distances to the two lines. Its locus \(\Gamma\) passes through \(M\).
(i) Describe the geometric relationship between \(\Gamma\) and \(L_1\).
(ii) Find the equation of \(\Gamma\).
(iii) \(\Gamma\) meets \(C\) at another point \(Q\). Someone claims that \(\angle QGN>73^\circ\). Do you agree? Explain. (6 marks)
questions.stemZh:
14. \(M=(-12,10)\)、\(N=(36,10)\) 在圓 \(C\) 上，圓心 \(G\) 的 \(y\) 坐標為 \(-8\)。
(a) 求 \(C\) 的方程。（2 分）
(b) \(L_1\) 經過 \(N,G\)，\(L_2\) 平行於 \(L_1\)。動點 \(P\) 到兩線的垂直距離相等，其軌跡 \(\Gamma\) 經過 \(M\)。
(i) 描述 \(\Gamma\) 與 \(L_1\) 的幾何關係。
(ii) 求 \(\Gamma\) 的方程。
(iii) \(\Gamma\) 與 \(C\) 的另一個交點為 \(Q\)。有人聲稱 \(\angle QGN>73^\circ\)。你是否同意？解釋答案。（6 分）
questions.hint: Midline parallel. Parallel through M. Cosine for angle.
questions.hintZh: 中線平行。過 M 平行線。cos 求角。
questions.solution:
(a) The perpendicular bisector of \(MN\) is \(x=12\), so \(G=(12,-8)\) and \(GM^2=900\). Thus \(C:(x-12)^2+(y+8)^2=900\).
(b)(i) The locus is the midline, parallel to \(L_1\).
(ii) The slope of \(NG\) is \(3/4\). The parallel through \(M\) is \(3x-4y+76=0\).
(iii) Let \(H\) be the perpendicular foot from \(G\) to chord \(MQ\). Then \(GH=144/5\) and \(GQ=30\), giving \(\cos\angle QGH=24/25\). As \(GN\) is parallel to the chord direction, the angle is \(\angle QGN=90^\circ-\cos^{-1}(24/25)\approx73.7398^\circ>73^\circ\). Agree.

questions.stem:
14. The equations of the straight lines \(L_1\) and \(L_2\) are
\[
3x+2y-5=0
\]and
\[
3x+2y+7=0
\]respectively. Let \(P\) be a moving point in the rectangular coordinate plane such that the perpendicular distance from \(P\) to \(L_1\) is equal to the perpendicular distance from \(P\) to \(L_2\). Denote the locus of \(P\) by \(\Gamma\).
(a) Find the equation of \(\Gamma\).
(b) The coordinates of the point \(Q\) are \((9,12)\). Let \(R\) be a point lying on \(\Gamma\) such that \(QR\) is the shortest distance from \(Q\) to \(\Gamma\).
(i) Find the coordinates of \(R\).
(ii) The equation of the circle \(C\) is
\[
x^2+y^2-2x+4y-164=0.
\]Let \(G\) be the centre of \(C\). It is given that the straight line \(QR\) cuts \(C\) at the points \(W\) and \(S\), while \(\Gamma\) cuts \(C\) at the points \(T\) and \(U\). Someone claims that the ratio of the area of \(\triangle WTU\) to that of \(\triangle GRS\) is \(7:2\). Is the claim correct? Explain your answer.
(9 marks)
questions.stemZh:
14. \(L_1:3x+2y-5=0\)、\(L_2:3x+2y+7=0\)。動點 \(P\) 到兩線的垂直距離相等，軌跡為 \(\Gamma\)。
(a) 求 \(\Gamma\) 方程。
(b) \(Q=(9,12)\)，\(R\) 為 \(\Gamma\) 上與 \(Q\) 最近的點。
(i) 求 \(R\) 坐標。
(ii) 圓 \(C:x^2+y^2-2x+4y-164=0\) 的圓心為 \(G\)。直線 \(QR\) 與圓交於 \(W,S\)，\(\Gamma\) 與圓交於 \(T,U\)。有人聲稱 \([WTU]:[GRS]=7:2\)。聲稱是否正確？解釋。（9 分）
questions.hint: Middle parallel. Perpendicular foot. Compare areas.
questions.hintZh: 中間平行。垂直垂足。比較面積。
questions.solution:
(a) The midline is 3x+2y+1=0.
(b)(i) The perpendicular through Q has equation 2x-3y+18=0; the foot is R=(-3,4).
(ii) G=(1,-2), radius 13, and TU=26. GR=2sqrt13 and RS=RW=3sqrt13. Thus [WTU]=39sqrt13 and [GRS]=39. The ratio sqrt13:1 is not 7:2.

questions.stem:
Lines \(L_1,L_2\) intersect perpendicularly at \(M\). \(P\) is equidistant from the two lines.
(a) Sketch and describe its locus.
(b) \(N\) lies on this locus and \(MN=5\) cm. Find its distance from \(L_1\), to 3 significant figures.
questions.stemZh:
直線 \(L_1,L_2\) 在 \(M\) 垂直相交。動點 \(P\) 與兩線等距。
(a) 畫出並描述其軌跡。
(b) \(N\) 位於此軌跡上，且 \(MN=5\) cm。求 \(N\) 到 \(L_1\) 的距離，取 3 位有效數字。
questions.hint: Angle bisectors at 45°. Distance = 5 sin45°.
questions.hintZh: 45° 角平分線。距離 = 5 sin45°。
questions.solution:
(a) The two perpendicular angle bisectors through \(M\), each at \(45^\circ\) to either line.
(b) The distance is \(5\sin45^\circ=5/\sqrt2\approx3.54\) cm.

questions.stem:
\(L:\sqrt3x-y-2=0\). \(P\) is equidistant from \(L\) and the \(x\)-axis.
(a) Describe the geometric relation between its locus and the two lines.
(b) Find both equations in surd form.
questions.stemZh:
\(L:\sqrt3x-y-2=0\)。動點 \(P\) 與 \(L\) 及 \(x\) 軸等距。
(a) 描述軌跡與兩直線的幾何關係。
(b) 求兩條方程，保留根式。
questions.hint: Equate distances to two lines, remove absolute value with ±.
questions.hintZh: 等距兩線，去絕對值用 ±。
questions.solution:
(a) The locus is the pair of angle bisectors.
(b) \(|\sqrt3x-y-2|/2=|y|\), hence \(\sqrt3x-y-2=\pm2y\). The equations are \(\sqrt3x-3y-2=0\) and \(\sqrt3x+y-2=0\).

questions.stem:
\(L_1:x-2y+10=0\) and \(L_2:x-2y-2=0\). \(P\) is equidistant from them; call its locus \(\Gamma\).
(a) Find \(\Gamma\).
(b) \(\Gamma\) meets the \(y\)-axis at \(A\) and \(L_2\) meets the \(x\)-axis at \(B\). Find the least area, in terms of \(\pi\), of a circle through \(A,B\).
questions.stemZh:
\(L_1:x-2y+10=0\)、\(L_2:x-2y-2=0\)。\(P\) 與兩線等距，軌跡為 \(\Gamma\)。
(a) 求 \(\Gamma\) 方程。
(b) \(\Gamma\) 與 \(y\) 軸交於 \(A\)，\(L_2\) 與 \(x\) 軸交於 \(B\)。求經過 \(A,B\) 的圓的最小面積，以 \(\pi\) 表示。
questions.hint: Middle parallel. Smallest circle through A,B has AB as diameter.
questions.hintZh: 中間平行。最小圓以 AB 為直徑。
questions.solution:
(a) The middle parallel is \(x-2y+4=0\).
(b) \(A=(0,2),B=(2,0)\) and \(AB^2=8\). The minimum radius is \(AB/2\), attained when \(AB\) is a diameter. Hence the least area is \(2\pi\).

(b) Prove \(A,O,A''\) are collinear.

questions.stem:
\(l_1:y=3x+5\). \(l_2\) is parallel to \(l_1\) with \(y\)-intercept \(15\). \(P\) is equidistant from the two lines; call its locus \(\Gamma\).
(a) Describe the relation between \(\Gamma,l_1\).
(b) State the \(y\)-intercept of \(\Gamma\) and its equation.
(c) \(Q\) on \(\Gamma\) is closest to the origin. Find \(Q\).
questions.stemZh:
\(l_1:y=3x+5\)。\(l_2\) 與 \(l_1\) 平行，\(y\) 截距為 \(15\)。\(P\) 與兩線等距，軌跡為 \(\Gamma\)。
(a) 描述 \(\Gamma,l_1\) 的關係。
(b) 寫出 \(\Gamma\) 的 \(y\) 截距及方程。
(c) \(Q\) 是 \(\Gamma\) 上距離原點最近的點。求 \(Q\)。
questions.hint: Middle parallel line. Perpendicular from O.
questions.hintZh: 中間平行線。O 的垂線。
questions.solution:
(a) They are parallel; \(\Gamma\) is the middle parallel.
(b) The intercept is \(10\), so \(y=3x+10\).
(c) The perpendicular from \(O\) has equation \(y=-x/3\). Solving gives \(Q=(-3,1)\).

questions.stem:
\(C:x^2+y^2-32x=0\) has centre \(A\) on the \(x\)-axis. A tangent \(L\) touches it below the \(x\)-axis at \(T\) and meets the positive \(x\)-axis at \(P\) to the right of \(C\).
(a) Find \(A\) and the radius.
(b) The inclination \(\theta\) of \(L\) satisfies \(\tan\theta=8/15\). (i) Find \(P\). (ii) Find \(L\).
(c) The circle moves along \(L\) on its original side, remaining tangent. (i) Find the locus of its centre. (ii) When \(P\) is the contact point, find the centre.
questions.stemZh:
\(C:x^2+y^2-32x=0\) 的圓心 \(A\) 在 \(x\) 軸上。切線 \(L\) 在 \(x\) 軸下方的 \(T\) 接觸圓，與圓右方的正 \(x\) 軸交於 \(P\)。
(a) 求 \(A\) 及半徑。
(b) \(L\) 的傾角 \(\theta\) 滿足 \(\tan\theta=8/15\)。(i) 求 \(P\)。(ii) 求 \(L\)。
(c) 圓在原來的一側沿 \(L\) 移動並保持相切。(i) 求圓心軌跡。(ii) 當 \(P\) 為接觸點時，求圓心。
questions.hint: Distance condition. Unit normal vector. Move 16 units.
questions.hintZh: 距離條件。單位法向量。移 16 單位。
questions.solution:
(a) \(A=(16,0),r=16\).
(b) Write \(L:8x-15y-8p=0\) with \(P=(p,0)\). The distance condition \(|128-8p|/17=16\) gives \(p=50\) or \(-18\). The stated position selects \(P=(50,0)\) and \(L:8x-15y-400=0\).
(c)(i) The same-side centre has \(8x-15y-400=-272\), hence \(8x-15y-128=0\).
(ii) Move \(16\) units from \(P\) in the original-side unit normal \((-8,15)/17\). The centre is \((722/17,240/17)\).

questions.stem:
The straight lines \(L_1: 3x+4y-20=0\) and \(L_2: 3x+4y+10=0\) are parallel. \(P\) is a moving point equidistant from \(L_1\) and \(L_2\). Denote the locus of \(P\) by \(\Gamma\).
(a) Find the equation of \(\Gamma\).
(b) The circle \(C\) has equation \(x^2+y^2-6x-8y+9=0\).
(i) Find the centre \(G\) and radius \(r\) of \(C\).
(ii) Show that \(\Gamma\) is tangent to \(C\) and find the point of tangency.
questions.stemZh:
\(L_1:3x+4y-20=0,L_2:3x+4y+10=0\)。\(P\) 與兩線等距，軌跡為 \(\Gamma\)。
(a) 求 \(\Gamma\)。
(b) \(C:x^2+y^2-6x-8y+9=0\)。(i) 求圓心 \(G\) 及半徑。(ii) 證明 \(\Gamma\) 與圓相切，並求切點。
questions.hint: Distance = radius → tangent. Foot of perpendicular is tangency point.
questions.hintZh: 距離 = 半徑 → 相切。垂足即切點。
questions.solution:
(a) \(\Gamma:3x+4y-5=0\).
(b)(i) \(G=(3,4),r=4\).
(ii) The centre-line distance is \(|9+16-5|/5=4\), equal to the radius. The perpendicular foot is \(G-(20/25)(3,4)=(3/5,4/5)\), the tangency point.

questions.stem:
The straight lines \(L_1: x+y-8=0\) and \(L_2: x-y=0\) intersect at point \(A\).
(a) Find the coordinates of \(A\).
(b) \(P\) is a moving point equidistant from \(L_1\) and \(L_2\). The locus of \(P\) consists of two straight lines \(\Gamma_1\) and \(\Gamma_2\). Find their equations.
(c) The circle \(C\) has equation \(x^2+y^2-6x-8y+k=0\), where \(k\) is a constant.
(i) Find the centre \(G\) and radius \(r\) of \(C\) in terms of \(k\), and state the condition on \(k\).
(ii) It is given that \(G\) lies on \(\Gamma_1\). If \(C\) is tangent to \(\Gamma_2\), find \(k\).
questions.stemZh:
\(L_1:x+y-8=0,L_2:x-y=0\)，交於 \(A\)。
(a) 求 \(A\)。
(b) \(P\) 與兩線等距，軌跡為 \(\Gamma_1,\Gamma_2\)。求其方程。
(c) \(C:x^2+y^2-6x-8y+k=0\)。(i) 以 \(k\) 表示圓心和半徑，並寫出 \(k\) 的條件。(ii) 圓心在 \(\Gamma_1\) 上；若圓與 \(\Gamma_2\) 相切，求 \(k\)。
questions.hint: Equate distances, absolute value gives two lines.
questions.hintZh: 等距，絕對值得兩線。
questions.solution:
(a) \(A=(4,4)\).
(b) \(|x+y-8|=|x-y|\) gives \(y=4\) or \(x=4\).
(c)(i) \(G=(3,4),r=\sqrt{25-k}\) and \(k<25\) for a non-degenerate real circle.
(ii) Label \(\Gamma_1:y=4\), \(\Gamma_2:x=4\). The distance to \(\Gamma_2\) is \(1\), so \(25-k=1\), giving \(k=24\).

questions.stem:
13. It is given that \(A\) and \(B\) are distinct points in a rectangular coordinate plane. Let \(P\) be a moving point in the rectangular coordinate plane such that \(A B=2 B P\).
(a) Describe the locus of \(P\).
(b) Denote the locus of \(P\) by \(\Gamma\). Let \(C\) be the point of intersection of \(\Gamma\) and \(A B\). Suppose that the coordinates of \(A\) and \(B\) are \((3,5)\) and \((11,5)\) respectively. Find
(i) the equation of \(\Gamma\),
(ii) the maximum area of \(\triangle A B P\),
(iii) the area of the region bounded by \(\Gamma, B C\) and \(B P\) when \(\angle A P B=90^{\circ}\).
questions.stemZh:
13. 已知 \(A\) 和 \(B\) 為直角坐標平面上的兩個不同定點。動點 \(P\) 在直角坐標平面上移動，並滿足 \(AB=2BP\)。
(a) 描述 \(P\) 的軌跡。
(b) 以 \(\Gamma\) 表示 \(P\) 的軌跡。設 \(C\) 為 \(\Gamma\) 與 \(AB\) 的交點。若 \(A\) 和 \(B\) 的坐標分別為 \((3,5)\) 和 \((11,5)\)，求：
(i) \(\Gamma\) 的方程；
(ii) \(\triangle ABP\) 的最大面積；
(iii) 當 \(\angle APB=90^\circ\) 時，由 \(\Gamma\)、\(BC\) 及 \(BP\) 所包圍區域的面積。
questions.hint: Circle centred at B. Max area when AB⊥BP. Sector area = πr²×θ/360.
questions.hintZh: 以 B 為心圓。AB⊥BP 面積最大。扇形 = πr²×θ/360。
questions.solution:
13.(a) & The locus of \(P\) is a circle with centre \(B\). 
(b)(i) & The equation of \(\Gamma\) :

\[
\begin{aligned}
& (x-11)^{2}+(y-5)^{2}=\left(\frac{11-3}{2}\right)^{2} \\
& (x-11)^{2}+(y-5)^{2}=16
\end{aligned}
\]

(ii) & 
Area of \(\triangle A B P\) is maximum when \(A B \perp B P\). 
Required area

\[
\begin{aligned}
& =\frac{1}{2} A B \cdot B P \\
& =\frac{1}{2}(11-3)(4) \\
& =16
\end{aligned}
\]

(iii) & The region is a sector.

\[
\begin{aligned}
& \begin{aligned}
\angle A B P & =\cos ^{-1} \frac{B P}{A B} \\
& =\cos ^{-1} \frac{4}{8} \\
& =60^{\circ}
\end{aligned} \\
& \text { Required area } \\
& =\pi(B P)^{2} \cdot \frac{60^{\circ}}{360^{\circ}} \\
& =\pi \cdot 4^{2} \cdot \frac{60^{\circ}}{360^{\circ}} \\
& =\frac{8 \pi}{3} \approx 8.38
\end{aligned}
\]

questions.stem:
14. The coordinates of points \(A\) and \(B\) are \((0,7)\) and \((k, 7)\) respectively. \(P\) is a moving point in the rectangular coordinate plane such that \(\angle A P B=90^{\circ}\). Denote the locus of \(P\) by \(\Gamma\).
(a) (i) Describe \(\Gamma\).
(ii) Find the equation of \(\Gamma\) in terms of \(k\).
(b) When the area of \(\triangle A B P\) attains its maximum, \(P\) lies above \(A B\) and on the straight line \(4 x-5 y+44=0\).
(i) Find the value of \(k\).
(ii) Find the perimeter of \(\triangle A B P\). Leave your answers in surd form.
14.
questions.stemZh:
14. 點 \(A=(0,7)\)、\(B=(k,7)\)。動點 \(P\) 滿足 \(\angle APB=90^\circ\)，以 \(\Gamma\) 表示 \(P\) 的軌跡。
(a) (i) 描述 \(\Gamma\)。
(ii) 以 \(k\) 表示 \(\Gamma\) 的方程。
(b) 當 \(\triangle ABP\) 面積最大時，\(P\) 位於 \(AB\) 上方，並在直線 \(4x-5y+44=0\) 上。
(i) 求 \(k\)；(ii) 求 \(\triangle ABP\) 的周界，答案以根式表示。
questions.hint: Angle in semicircle. Max area at top of circle.
questions.hintZh: 半圓角。圓頂最大面積。
questions.solution:
(a)(i) By the angle in a semicircle theorem, \(\Gamma\) is the circle with diameter \(AB\), excluding \(A\) and \(B\).
(ii) Its centre is \((\frac{k}{2},7)\) and its radius is \(\frac{|k|}{2}\), so

\[
\left(x-\frac{k}{2}\right)^2+(y-7)^2=\frac{k^2}{4}.
\]

(b)(i) At maximum area above \(AB\), \(P=(\frac{k}{2},7+\frac{|k|}{2})\). If \(k>0\), substituting into the line gives \(k=18\). If \(k<0\), the same substitution gives \(k=-2\). The source does not explicitly restrict the sign of \(k\), so both branches satisfy the typed conditions.
(ii) For \(k=18\), \(P=(9,16)\), \(AP=BP=9\sqrt2\) and the perimeter is \(18+18\sqrt2\). For \(k=-2\), \(P=(-1,8)\), \(AP=BP=\sqrt2\) and the perimeter is \(2+2\sqrt2\).

questions.stem:
13. Let \(O\) be the origin. The straight lines \(L_1\) and \(L_2:2x+3y+24=0\) are perpendicular to each other and intersect at \(A\). \(L_1\) and \(L_2\) cut the \(x\)-axis at \(M\) and \(B\) respectively, where \(M\) is the midpoint of \(OB\).
(a) Find the equation of \(L_1\). (3 marks)
(b) \(P\) is a moving point in the same coordinate plane such that \(PA=PB\). Denote the locus of \(P\) by \(\Gamma\).
(i) Describe the geometric relationship between \(\Gamma\) and \(L_1\). Explain your answer.
(ii) Find the equation of \(\Gamma\). (4 marks)
questions.stemZh:
13. \(O\) 為原點。互相垂直的直線 \(L_1,L_2:2x+3y+24=0\) 相交於 \(A\)。兩線分別與 \(x\) 軸交於 \(M,B\)，其中 \(M\) 是 \(OB\) 中點。
(a) 求 \(L_1\) 方程。（3 分）
(b) 動點 \(P\) 滿足 \(PA=PB\)，軌跡為 \(\Gamma\)。
(i) 描述 \(\Gamma\) 與 \(L_1\) 的關係並解釋；(ii) 求 \(\Gamma\) 方程。（4 分）
questions.hint: Both perpendicular to L₂ → parallel. Find actual midpoint.
questions.hintZh: 皆垂直 L₂ → 平行。找實際中點。
questions.solution:
(a) B=(-12,0), M=(-6,0); L1:3x-2y+18=0.
(b)(i) Gamma and L1 are both perpendicular to L2, hence parallel.
(ii) A=(-102/13,-36/13), so the actual midpoint of AB is (-129/13,-18/13). The parallel through it is 3x-2y+27=0. The source's midpoint identification was incorrect although its final line is correct.

questions.stem:
12. In the rectangular coordinate plane, the coordinates of points \(A\), \(B\), \(C\) and \(R\) are \((-1,0)\), \((7,6)\), \((7,0)\) and \((3,3)\) respectively. \(P\) is a moving point in the rectangular coordinate plane such that \(AP\) is perpendicular to \(BP\). Denote the locus of \(P\) by \(\Gamma\).
(a) Find the equation of \(\Gamma\). (2 marks)
(b) The equation of the straight line \(L\) is \(4x+3y+104=0\). It is found that \(\Gamma\) and \(L\) do not intersect. Let \(Q\) be a point lying on \(L\) such that \(Q\) is nearest to \(R\).
(i) Find the distance between \(Q\) and \(R\).
(ii) Winston claims that the ratio of the area of \(\triangle ARC\) to the area of \(\triangle AQC\) is \(1:4\). Do you agree? Explain your answer.
(5 marks)
questions.hint: Dot product = 0 → right angle → diameter circle. Heights ratio.
questions.hintZh: 點積 = 0 → 直角 → 直徑圓。高比。
questions.solution:
(a) The dot-product equation gives (x-3)^2+(y-3)^2=25, excluding A,B.
(b)(i) The point-to-line distance is 125/5=25.
(ii) The foot is Q=(-17,-12). On common horizontal base AC the heights are 3 and 12; ratio 1:4, so agree.

questions.stem:
Rotate \(A=(-1,-3)\) anticlockwise by \(90^\circ\) about the origin to \(A'\). Reflect \(B=(-9,-1)\) in the \(y\)-axis to \(B'\). \(P\) satisfies \(A'P\perp B'P\).
(a) Find \(A',B'\).
(b) Find the locus of \(P\).
(c) Find the circumcentre of \(A'PB'\).
(d) \(Q\) is its centroid. Find the locus of \(Q\).
questions.stemZh:
把 \(A=(-1,-3)\) 繞原點逆時針旋轉 \(90^\circ\) 得 \(A'\)；把 \(B=(-9,-1)\) 關於 \(y\) 軸反射得 \(B'\)。\(P\) 滿足 \(A'P\perp B'P\)。
(a) 求 \(A',B'\)。
(b) 求 \(P\) 的軌跡。
(c) 求三角形 \(A'PB'\) 的外心。
(d) \(Q\) 為該三角形重心。求 \(Q\) 的軌跡。
questions.hint: Diameter circle. Coordinate transformation u=3x-12.
questions.hintZh: 直徑圓。坐標變換 u=3x-12。
questions.solution:
(a) \(A'=(3,-1),B'=(9,-1)\).
(b) The diameter-circle is \((u-6)^2+(v+1)^2=9\), or \(u^2+v^2-12u+2v+28=0\), excluding the two endpoints.
(c) The circumcentre is the midpoint of the hypotenuse, \((6,-1)\).
(d) If \(Q=(x,y)\), then \(u=3x-12,v=3y+2\). Substitution gives \((x-6)^2+(y+1)^2=1\). Exclude \((5,-1),(7,-1)\), the images of the forbidden endpoints.

questions.stem:
\(A=(1,3),B=(9,15)\) and \(P\) satisfies \(PA\perp PB\).
(a) Find the locus of \(P\).
(b) \(L\) passes through \(P\) and the midpoint of \(AB\) when \([PAB]\) is greatest.
(i) Find \(L\).
(ii) A student claims \((-1,13)\) is another intersection of \(L\) and the locus. Do you agree? Explain.
questions.stemZh:
\(A=(1,3),B=(9,15)\)，\(P\) 滿足 \(PA\perp PB\)。
(a) 求 \(P\) 軌跡。
(b) 當 \([PAB]\) 最大時，\(L\) 經過 \(P\) 及 \(AB\) 中點。
(i) 求 \(L\)。
(ii) 有學生聲稱 \((-1,13)\) 是 \(L\) 與軌跡的另一交點。你是否同意？解釋。
questions.hint: Diameter circle. Perpendicular direction to AB.
questions.hintZh: 直徑圓。垂直 AB 方向。
questions.solution:
(a) The diameter-circle is \((x-5)^2+(y-9)^2=52\), excluding \(A,B\).
(b)(i) Greatest height occurs in the perpendicular direction to \(AB\), whose slope is \(3/2\). Thus \(L:y-9=-2(x-5)/3\), or \(2x+3y-37=0\).
(ii) Agree: \((-1,13)\) satisfies the line and \((-1-5)^2+(13-9)^2=52\). The other intersection is \((11,5)\).

questions.stem:
The coordinates of \(A\) and \(B\) are \((0,5)\) and \((3,1)\) respectively. Let \(P\) be a moving point such that \(AP\perp PB\). The locus of \(P\) lies on a circle \(\Gamma\).
(a) Find the equation of \(\Gamma\).
(b) \(Q\) is a moving point on \(\Gamma\). \(C=(0,1)\) is a point in the same plane.
(i) Does \(\Gamma\) pass through \(C\)? Explain your answer.
(ii) When the slope of \(CQ\) is \(\sqrt{3}\), someone claims that \(\angle CAQ\) is greater than \(100°\). Do you agree? Explain your answer.
questions.stemZh:
\(A=(0,5),B=(3,1)\)。\(P\) 滿足 \(AP\perp PB\)，軌跡位於圓 \(\Gamma\) 上。
(a) 求 \(\Gamma\) 方程。
(b) \(Q\) 在 \(\Gamma\) 上，\(C=(0,1)\)。(i) 圓是否經過 \(C\)？解釋。(ii) 若 \(CQ\) 斜率為 \(\sqrt3\)，\(\angle CAQ\) 是否大於 \(100^\circ\)？解釋。
questions.hint: Complete square. Check C on circle. Angle sum.
questions.hintZh: 配方。檢查 C 在圓上。角和。
questions.solution:
(a) \(\Gamma:x^2+y^2-3x-6y+5=0\), centre \((3/2,3)\), radius \(5/2\); the original locus excludes \(A,B\).
(b)(i) Yes: at \(C\), \(1-6+5=0\).
(ii) The second intersection with \(y=\sqrt3x+1\) is \(Q=((3+4\sqrt3)/4,4+3\sqrt3/4)\). (The point \(C\) itself cannot define slope \(CQ\).) Since \(\tan\angle CAB=3/4\) and the chord direction makes \(60^\circ\) with the horizontal, \(\angle CAQ=60^\circ+\arctan(3/4)\approx96.87^\circ\). Disagree.

(ii) The tangent length is \(\sqrt{16-8}=2\sqrt2\).

(b) Find the locus of \(Q\).
questions.hint: Midpoint substitution. Substitute and complete square.
questions.hintZh: 中點代入。配方。
questions.solution:
(a) By the midpoint formula, \(P=(2x-1,2y-1)\).
(b) Substitution gives \((2x-1)^2+(2y-1)^2=1\), hence \(4x^2+4y^2-4x-4y+1=0\). Its centre is \((1/2,1/2)\) and radius is \(1/2\).

questions.stem:
\(A=(a,0)\) and \(B=(0,b)\) move on the coordinate axes with \(AB=4\). \(P=(x,y)\) is their midpoint.
(a) Express \(a,b\) in terms of \(x,y\).
(b) Find the locus of \(P\).
questions.stemZh:
\(A=(a,0)\)、\(B=(0,b)\) 分別在坐標軸上移動，且 \(AB=4\)。\(P=(x,y)\) 是 \(AB\) 中點。
(a) 以 \(x,y\) 表示 \(a,b\)。
(b) 求 \(P\) 的軌跡方程。
questions.hint: Scale coordinates. No sign restriction → full circle.
questions.hintZh: 坐標倍數。無符號限制 → 全圓。
questions.solution:
(a) \(a=2x,b=2y\).
(b) \(a^2+b^2=16\), so \(4x^2+4y^2=16\) and \(x^2+y^2=4\). No sign restriction is given on \(a,b\), so retain the complete circle.

questions.stem:
\(P\) moves on \(v=-u^2+2u+6\). \(R=(1,3)\) lies on segment \(PQ\) with \(PR:RQ=1:2\); \(Q=(x,y)\).
(a) Express \(P\) in terms of \(x,y\).
(b) Find the locus of \(Q\).
questions.hint: Internal division formula 3R=2P+Q.
questions.hintZh: 內分點 3R=2P+Q。
questions.solution:
(a) The internal division formula gives \(3R=2P+Q\), so \(P=((3-x)/2,(9-y)/2)\).
(b) Substitute into the original curve: \((9-y)/2=-(3-x)^2/4+(3-x)+6\). Simplifying gives \(y=x^2/2-x-9/2\).

questions.stem:
Denote the origin by \(O\).
(a) \(A\) and \(B\) are points on the positive \(x\)-axis such that the \(x\)-coordinate of \(A\) is greater than that of \(B\). A vertical line through \(B\) cuts the line \(y=mx\) at point \(C\), where \(m\) is a positive constant with \(AB=BC\). Let \(D\) be a point such that \(ABCD\) is a square. Express the slope of \(OD\) in terms of \(m\).
(b) The coordinates of \(M\) and \(N\) are \((6,5)\) and \((10,0)\) respectively. Let \(P\) and \(Q\) lie on \(OM\) and \(MN\) respectively, and let \(R\) and \(S\) lie on the \(x\)-axis. If \(PQRS\) is a square, find the \(x\)-coordinate of \(P\).
questions.stemZh:
\(O\) 為原點。
(a) \(A,B\) 在正 \(x\) 軸上，\(A\) 的 \(x\) 坐標大於 \(B\)。經過 \(B\) 的垂直線與 \(y=mx\) 交於 \(C\)，其中 \(m>0\) 且 \(AB=BC\)。\(ABCD\) 為正方形。以 \(m\) 表示 \(OD\) 的斜率。
(b) \(M=(6,5),N=(10,0)\)；\(P,Q\) 分別在 \(OM,MN\) 上，\(R,S\) 在 \(x\) 軸上。若 \(PQRS\) 為正方形，求 \(P\) 的 \(x\) 坐標。
questions.hint: Parameterise B. Square side = height h.
questions.hintZh: 參數 B。正方形邊 = 高 h。
questions.solution:
(a) Put \(B=(b,0)\). Then \(C=(b,mb),A=(b+mb,0),D=(b+mb,mb)\). Thus the slope is \(m/(m+1)\).
(b) \(OM:y=5x/6\) and \(MN:y=-5x/4+25/2\). Let the common height of \(P,Q\) be \(h\). The square side is \(h\), so \(x_Q=x_P+h\) and \(h=5x_P/6\). Substituting into \(MN\) gives \(5x_P/6=-55x_P/24+25/2\), hence \(x_P=4\).

questions.stem:
Denote the origin by \(O\). The coordinates of \(A\) and \(B\) are \((2t,\,3t)\) and \((5t,\,5t)\) respectively, where \(t\) is a positive constant. Denote the reflection image of \(A\) with respect to \(OB\) by \(C\).
(a) Someone claims that \(OABC\) is a rhombus. Do you agree? Explain your answer.
(b) If the area of \(OABC\) is \(245\), find the coordinates of \(C\).
questions.hint: Rhombus: all sides equal. Area = diagonal product /2.
questions.hintZh: 菱形：四邊等。面積 = 對角線積/2。
questions.solution:
(a) \(OB:y=x\), so \(C=(3t,2t)\). The four sides all have length \(\sqrt{13}t\); thus it is a rhombus.
(b) Its perpendicular diagonals have lengths \(OB=5\sqrt2t\) and \(AC=\sqrt2t\). Area \(=5t^2=245\), so \(t=7\) and \(C=(21,14)\).
